text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Osaka Hai. Super
Creek is
bursting with energy from doing
her best for me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс drops by to cheer her on
by saying
she's looking forward to their
contest at the
spring Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик heads to the track to make
Tamamo
Cross proud.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
